title: Cargo and Crates.io
summary: More of Cargo: release profiles, documentation comments and a convenient public API with pub use, publishing to crates.io, workspaces of several crates, installing binaries, and extending Cargo with custom commands.
goals: Customize dev and release profiles in Cargo.toml
Write documentation comments with examples and shape a public API with pub use re-exports
Publish, version and yank a crate on crates.io
Organize related crates in a workspace, and install and extend Cargo tools
